description: Drug-drug interaction text from the FDA label (openFDA) of drug A that mentions drug B: matching sentences from the label's drug interactions section, with label set ID and effective date. Label text only; no severity score. If no sentence matches, that does NOT mean there is no interaction. Choose this tool for: Drug-drug interaction text from the FDA label of drug. Close alternatives on this server: health_daily_med_label_spl (NLM DailyMed drug label listings matching a drug name); health_fda_adverse_events_faers (FDA FAERS drug adverse event reports for a generic drug).
